text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Sorry to interrupt our rehearsal 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There's somewhere I want us to go. 
...All of us, together.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's Tokyo Racecourse—♪
choice_data_list: Is this where you wanted to go?
Is this where you wanted to go?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've been thinking about it this 
whole time. 
What kind of person stood beside an 
umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And then I realized. 
The most important part was always the 
same.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, do you guys remember too?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In a race against an opponent you just 
couldn't bear to lose to. 
In a race for a glory you were desperate 
to claim.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Out of breath. Hurting all over. 
Refusing to give up, squeezing out every 
last ounce of strength—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And right when your legs felt too heavy to 
move...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it, Daiwa Scarlet!" 
"Run, Scarlet!" "Win this!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The people praying for me... 
the people betting their dreams on me... 
...they always called out my name.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer. My friends. My fans. 
...Even people who only just saw me for 
the first time in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whenever everyone entrusts their dreams to 
me, 
that name is always bridging the gap.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All those prayers poured through that 
name— 
we turned them into strength, and we ran.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's why—I want to carry the dreams 
of every single person who calls my name.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just like how umamusume have always pushed 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to shoulder as many dreams as I can 
at this year's Goshiki Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Through that bond between humans and 
umamusume... 
this bond called a "name."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So this year, as part of each ritual, 
I want to add a moment where our names are 
called.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it might not seem like 
such a massive change. But...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If all of us taking part in the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai 
can truly cherish the names people call 
us— 
...I feel like something miraculous could 
happen.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. 
It shall be as your hearts desire.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And so! For our Votive Dance, 
Maya thinks we should make a moment 
where everyone calls our names too!

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Okay!" 
"How should we do it, exactly?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... The Votive Dance is all about 
bringing the crowd 
and all of us dancers together as one, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could totally do a live concert 
call-and-response! 
...Wait, would we run out of time!?

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha!" "Still, it'd be fun to do 
something!" 
"Let's make it super hype★" "......"

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text: .........Having our names called, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Would you not want people calling your 
name during the dance?

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? 
U-Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you don't want to, it's totally fine to 
say so! 
Don't worry, Maya will talk it over with 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Maya would way rather you just 
tell me straight 
whatever's worrying you! That way—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We can know from the bottom of our hearts 
that we've really become close friends 
over these three years, right?

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text: .........Maya-chan.

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's not like that. It's not that I 
don't want it.

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I just wondered... if anyone out there 
would even call my name. 
I got a little anxious, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm not super popular like you or 
Scarlet-chan. 
...It'd feel pretty lonely if no one 
called out for me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! 
Alright, time for a little field trip!

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No worries, no worries! 
Special drive, prepare for takeoff☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ 
Thanks for indulging my selfish request!

At Mayano Top Gun's request, I hit the 
road. 
Besides her, several other umamusume 
participating 
in the ritual were in the car.
choice_data_list: (This is for their sake, isn't it?)

text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is remarkably perceptive. 
As the "Divine Steed" leading the Votive 
Dance, 
I'll leave things in her capable hands 
from here on.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We're heeere! 
Alright, everyone, guess where we are!

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...A shrine? 
And it's the one closest to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ding ding ding! 
And here's what I want you to see!

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...? An ema rack?

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, Maya-chan? 
Did you want to write a wish on an ema?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Bzzt! Wrong answer! 
This is the closest shrine to the academy, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So academy instructors and fans 
come here all the time to dedicate ema.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, crouch down a bit. 
Can you see way in the back of the second 
tier from the bottom?

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ......From the bottom...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Dedicated Dance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"May —— make her racing debut" 
"May she meet her Trainer"... 
——... Ah, wait, this is...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep. The name written on that ema... 
is yours.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
People are watching umamusume 
a looot more closely than you think!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whether they're running in races, 
haven't made their debut yet, 
or already finished racing and chose a 
different path.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ......Actually, same goes for Maya.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to win for real, and stand in 
the spotlight. 
I want to be an umamusume who makes 
everyone's eyes sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But back when Maya couldn't even run in 
races yet, 
and was so far from that sparkling dream—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There was still someone who found me and 
called my name. 
Saying, "Please don't give up on your 
dream, Maya." 
...My fated person did.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Humans love umamusume so, so much! 
They really cherish us!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...And umamusume love them right back.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You and me both—we're definitely bound 
to someone precious by our names!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
"What one inscribes upon the plaque 
is the form of the bond they hold 
dearest."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
——......... 
Because having someone precious call our 
name 
is how we're entrusted with their 
cherished dreams...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume and humans are connected. 
And umamusume can turn the prayers poured 
into our names 
into strength...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's it! In that case, 
the form of the bond we want to cherish 
most is...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
——Um, so that means the part in the Votive 
Dance 
where our names get called will be before 
and after the dance, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And also, check this out! 
Remember the bond plaques we dedicate 
before the dance?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to write down the bond you 
cherish most, right? 
So if Scarlet-chan and everyone want to 
carry the dreams of those who call our 
names—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—why don't we try writing our own names? 
The "names" that tie us to the people who 
believe in us. 
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Oh, Mayano... 
You really understand everything, 
and always come up with the most wonderful 
answers.
